newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Eng Kong gets nod for Singapore SESDAQ listing.
newsitem.headline: Eng Kong gets nod for Singapore SESDAQ listing.

text.p: Shipping container service firm Eng Kong Holdings (Pte) Ltd said on Monday it had received in-principle approval to list its shares on the Stock Exchange of Singapore Dealing and Automated Quotation System (SESDAQ), Singapore's secondary share board.
The company said in a statement it had operations in Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia and Thailand.
It said it made a pre-tax profit of Singapore $4.6 million in 1996 on a turnover of S$27 million.
The statement gave no timing or details of the proposed share offer. Companies usually list within two months of receiving approval.
